name: Two peaks: the broad hill
lesson: A broad low hill and a narrow tall one: selection prefers what scores best now, and early on that is the broad hill.
lookFor: With this seed the whole population ends on the broad hill around (−2.5, −2.5), where the best fitness is 0.6, and never reaches the narrow hill at (3, 3), whose top scores 1; the run goes on to generation 100 with nothing better, and the diversity has fallen to 0.02. A run that settles on the wrong hill is the expected result here, not a mistake: with seeds 1 to 100, 84 runs end on the broad hill and 16 find the narrow one.
